surfaces.label: Personal-agent final-video evidence admission
surfaces.notes: Fresh live authentication, borrowed-lease private replay, canonical public/private equality and disposal are mandatory.

surfaces.label: Standalone personal-agent comparison publication
surfaces.notes: The builder now loads canonical mode-0600 inputs, authenticates the live release once, replays the private 72-run pair and requires exact public parity before rendering.

surfaces.label: Public aggregate schema and story coverage

surfaces.riskArea: Private nested fields or false 12-story coverage

surfaces.label: VoiceOver manifest and frame identity

surfaces.label: HTML, network and subprocess boundary
surfaces.notes: Data-derived values are escaped, rendering is offline with request abortion, and fixed media tools receive argument arrays without a shell.

surfaces.label: Path and output boundary
